completed.basis: direct jobs[].finished_at from the exhaustively paginated organization-wide finished/active/created build cohort union
completed.limitation: REST page-number pagination is not a transactional snapshot; a job dynamically added to an older terminal parent build can also escape all parent-build filters.

incoming.basis: direct jobs[].runnable_at from the exhaustively paginated organization-wide finished/active/created build cohort union
incoming.limitation: REST page-number pagination is not a transactional snapshot; a job dynamically added to an older terminal parent build can also escape all parent-build filters.

served.basis: direct jobs[].started_at from the exhaustively paginated organization-wide finished/active/created build cohort union
served.limitation: REST page-number pagination is not a transactional snapshot; a job dynamically added to an older terminal parent build can also escape all parent-build filters.

coverage.reason: No complete current API collection covers the rolling window.

provenance.retry_semantics: Every hashed job UUID is one attempt. is_retry means retry_source, retry_type, or a positive retries_count was present; retried marks an attempt superseded by another retry. Throughput counts attempts, not retry chains.

source_field_contract.queue: builds[].jobs[].cluster_queue_id resolved through the cluster queues endpoint
source_field_contract.queue_wait_seconds: started_at - runnable_at; null unless both direct timestamps exist
source_field_contract.runtime_seconds: finished_at - started_at; null unless both direct timestamps exist
